description: Context rules for low-sensitivity utilities with no account, payment, or regulated-data workflow.

effect.appProfileImpact: For low-sensitivity utilities, exported services or receivers are usually review items unless they can change state, trigger expensive work, or interact with sensitive platform capabilities.
For low-sensitivity utilities without accounts or payments, backup is usually a review item. Confirm it contains only harmless preferences or cache.
The profile says external integrations are not expected. Third-party SDKs may still be legitimate, but should be justified and disclosed.
For simple utilities, SDKs are shown mainly as privacy/disclosure context unless the profile says integrations are unexpected.
